        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # the pair of guide bars.
    marker = min(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    guide = next(v for v in colors if v != marker)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    guide_cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == guide]

    for r, c in seeds:

            rr, cc = r + dr, c
            while 0 <= rr < h and grid[rr][cc] != guide:
                out[rr][cc] = marker
                rr += dr
    return out
